t: DEWALT Bolster safety boots offer essential foot protection for demanding work environments. Ideal for construction workers, plumbers, and general tradespeople requiring reliable footwear on site. These lace-up boots feature a durable nubuck leather upper and a steel toe cap, providing 200 joules of impact protection. The dual-density phylon and rubber sole ensures comfort and shock absorption throughout the day. With a padded tongue and collar, they offer enhanced comfort. The outsole is resistant to fuel oil and withstands temperatures up to 300°C, ensuring durability and safety in various conditions.
